name: JellyShelf
description: Reads a Calibre metadata.db (read-only) and populates genres, tags, authors, series, titles and covers for the book library. Files stay in place; original Calibre paths are preserved.
overview: Read Calibre metadata.db read-only to enrich the Jellyfin book library.

versions.changelog: 1.5.0.0 - EPUB reader (reflowable text via foliate-js): selectable fonts incl. OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible, font size, line spacing, column width, justification, light/sepia/night themes, table of contents and a progress bar. Reading preferences and the last position in each book now sync per Jellyfin account across devices (PDF, comics and EPUB).

1.4.0.0 - In-browser reader at /JellyShelf/?id=<itemId>: PDF (pdf.js) and comics (CBZ/CBR/7z/tar via SharpCompress), with pointer-anchored zoom (wheel/pinch, 200% cap), fit width/page, rotation, vertical lazy rendering and horizontal page-by-page.

1.3.4.0 - Mirror folder: each intermediate folder (type, series...) gets a representative folder.jpg linked to a book cover inside it. Metadata reader renamed 'Calibre' -> 'JellyShelf' in library metadata settings.
1.3.3.0 - Simplified config: removed the Collections feature and hid advanced metadata toggles (kept at defaults). Config page now shows only Calibre path, type->genre and the mirror folder settings.
1.3.2.0 - Mirror folder: resolve path collisions (same type/series/title) by appending ' (2)', ' (3)'... so no book is dropped. (Supersedes 1.3.1.0, whose release was built from stale code.)

1.3.0.0 - Mirror folder (symlink tree) for a dedicated book-only library page (not mixed with films/collections): shortcuts to Calibre books arranged by a template (e.g. {#type}/{series?}/{title}). Calibre read-only; links in a separate folder.

1.3.0.0 - Mirror folder (symlink tree) for a dedicated book-only library page (not mixed with films/collections): shortcuts to Calibre books arranged by a template (e.g. {#type}/{series?}/{title}). Calibre read-only; links in a separate folder.

1.2.0.0 - Configurable collections by Calibre variable (e.g. 'Type - | {#type}', 'Serie - | {series}'): one collection per field value, via the Jellyfin API, nothing written to disk, Calibre read-only.
1.1.0.0 - #type column -> genre, tags -> Jellyfin tags, scheduled task building one collection per Calibre series.
